title: Zesty Velvety Middle Eastern Lamb Shawarma
description: Savory and cozy Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb, soy sauce, and ayurvedic-rajasic friendly spices, served in a tagine pot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, cumin, and coriander, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 300 degrees for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the cooked lamb and serving it in the pita bread with tahini sauce, pickled turnips, and any desired toppings.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
